anat.desc: Path to the 3D nifti file containing the anatomy image for reference and visualization.

labels.desc: List of the names of the regions.

maps.desc: 3D :class:`~nibabel.nifti1.Nifti1Image`. The image contains integer values for each network. The provided images are in MNI152 space and have shapes equal to ``(256, 256, 256, 1)``. They contain consecutive integers values from 0 (background) to either 7 or 17 depending on the atlas version considered.
